summary: Align Technology filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 disclosing an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with Goldman Sachs to buy back $270 million of common stock under its $1.0 billion April 2025 repurchase program, which had $600 million remaining. Align prepays $270 million and receives an initial delivery of roughly 1.44 million shares; final share count settles against the volume-weighted average price over the repurchase period, less a discount, with final settlement expected no later than about December 29, 2026. The structure leaves a residual true-up where either party may deliver additional shares or cash; watch the settlement share count and implied average repurchase price as the overhang clears.
